newsitem.title: USA: Accustaff Inc sees strong Q4, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Accustaff Inc sees strong Q4, 1997.

text.p: AccuStaff Inc on Thursday said is expects strong results in its 1996 fourth quarter and for the fiscal 1997 year.,
AccuStaff's chairman, president, and chief executive officer Derek Dewan, in a statement said, "the outlook for our fourth quarter and for 1997 remains strong."

He continued, "We fully expect to meet or exceed analysts expectations for the fourth quarter and fully year. With the completion of the acquisition of Career Horizons in November, we expect our 1997 revenues to exceed $1.7 billion and our margins to continue to improve."
AccuStaff is a national provider of strategic staffing and outsourcing services. Dewan's comment were in response concerns about the outlook for the industry, he said.
